criteria.criterion: gh/remote.rs holds the Remote trait, GitRemote, its impl and helpers used only by them; gh/pages.rs holds PAGES_WORKFLOW, PagesRun, PagesHost, the GhClient impl of PagesHost, PagesReport, the PAGES_* wait constants, wait_pages_run and watch_pages. Moved text is identical to the old text apart from visibility and import lines (git diff shows moved blocks unchanged).
criteria.evidence: I diffed the old mod.rs blob against new pages.rs: 5 insertions, and pages.rs is 198 lines, so the other 193 lines match old lines in the same order. The 5 new lines are the `//!` header and the use lines (super::{GhClient, Poll}, crate::Ui, anyhow::Result, athena_data::records::HostOperation). Against new remote.rs: 3 insertions (the header, `use anyhow::{Result, bail}` and `use athena_git::Git`). Both files hold every item the criterion lists, plus the private PAGES_APPEAR_LOOKS, which only wait_pages_run and watch_pages use. No visibility had to change.

criteria.criterion: gh/mod.rs declares the remote and pages modules and re-exports every previously public name with pub use, so gh::Remote, gh::GitRemote, gh::PagesHost, gh::PagesReport, gh::watch_pages and other public paths are unchanged.
criteria.evidence: mod.rs adds `mod pages; mod remote;`, `pub use pages::{PAGES_WAIT_DELAY, PAGES_WAIT_LOOKS, PAGES_WORKFLOW, PagesHost, PagesReport, PagesRun, watch_pages}` and `pub use remote::{GitRemote, Remote}`. These are all the moved pub items. The private wait_pages_run and PAGES_APPEAR_LOOKS were never public, so they need no re-export. athena-cli/tests/external_calls.rs imports `athena_core::gh::{PagesHost, Remote, watch_pages, ...}` and `athena_core::gh::PagesReport`; it compiles and its 11 tests pass.

criteria.criterion: Existing tests, including after_a_merge_the_branch_is_resynced_then_pages_watched_then_code_health_checked, are edited only on import lines; no test is added, removed or renamed.
criteria.evidence: The mod.rs diff touches only the module header lines and the two moved blocks (old lines 282-360 and 717-907). The test modules are untouched, not even their import lines. The -G search for added or removed test markers or zero-argument fns returns nothing. The named test (gh::after_merge_tests::...) passes.

criteria.criterion: No file outside crates/athena-core/src/gh/ names a moved item by an old module path (gh::remote::... or gh::pages::... would be new internal paths only); the verifier confirms with a Grep over crates/ for those paths and for moved names, finding every caller still uses the gh:: re-export.
criteria.evidence: Grep over crates/ for `gh::(remote|pages)::` and `gh::(Pages*|PAGES_*|watch_pages|Remote|GitRemote)`: no hit for gh::remote:: or gh::pages::. The hits are test_support.rs:19 (doc link crate::gh::GitRemote) and test_support.rs:309 (`impl crate::gh::Remote for EarlyFake`), plus external_calls.rs:330 (athena_core::gh::PagesReport). Grep for the moved names finds them only in gh/{mod,pages,remote}.rs, test_support.rs (GitRemote imported through crate::gh at line 55) and athena-cli/tests/external_calls.rs (imported through athena_core::gh at lines 8-10). Every caller uses the gh:: re-export. These were Grep tool calls, not Bash commands.

criteria.evidence: I read the diff. CHANGELOG.md gets a new bullet under ### Changed: 'Structure pass job G3 ... move unchanged into gh/remote.rs ... gh/pages.rs ... Behavior is unchanged; the list from cargo test -- --list is the same.' Its item list matches the code.

findings.summary: Intra-doc link [`check_replace`] in the moved Remote::replace doc no longer resolves
findings.evidence: Old mod.rs had check_replace in scope through `use crate::pr::{..., check_replace, ...}`. remote.rs imports only anyhow and athena_git::Git, so rustdoc would report a broken intra-doc link. This comes from the verbatim-move rule. I found no cargo doc or RUSTDOCFLAGS in the repository, so no check fails. A later docs job could write it as [`crate::pr::check_replace`].

findings.summary: I could not see the producer's caller-check report (section 5 rule 5), so I ran the check myself
findings.evidence: The request says 'the report lists the caller check for each moved name'. That report is not in the snapshot. I ran the Grep under criterion 4 instead: every hit outside gh/ uses the gh:: re-export.

summary: The change does what G3 asks. The Remote trait, GitRemote and its impl move into gh/remote.rs. The Pages items move into gh/pages.rs: PAGES_WORKFLOW, PagesRun, PagesHost and its GhClient impl, PagesReport, the PAGES_* constants, wait_pages_run and watch_pages. In both cases the text is unchanged. To check this I diffed the old mod.rs blob against each new file. Only 5 lines in pages.rs and 3 in remote.rs are new, all of them `//!` headers or `use` lines; every other line keeps its old order. The diff of mod.rs itself only removes the moved blocks and adds `mod`/`pub use` lines, and no test line changes. Every caller outside gh/ (test_support.rs, athena-cli/tests/external_calls.rs) still imports through the gh:: re-exports. The section 5.1 proof test passes, and so do the 11 CLI external_calls tests. The recorded fmt, clippy and test checks pass. CHANGELOG has a G3 entry. One minor issue: because the move is verbatim, the `[check_replace]` doc link in remote.rs no longer resolves. This only affects rustdoc, and no repository check runs rustdoc. I could not see the producer's report, so I ran the caller grep myself.
